Plating buildup will push the finished size out of tolerance, causing assembly interference; the designer must either add a pre-plate allowance to D21 or specify masking.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the 20±0.02 dimension applies after plating, or reduce the nominal by the expected plating thickness so the final coated size remains within tolerance."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"2-⌀15"}],"comment":"The two ⌀15 holes (D5) are likely mounting or locating features on a cylinder rod mount but carry no fit or tolerance callout, leaving them to the general machining tolerance of ±0.5 mm. Without a defined tolerance, mating pins or bolts may not assemble correctly or locate the part reliably; the designer should assign an appropriate fit or tolerance class to these holes.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit or tolerance callout (e.g., H7 or H9) to dimension D5 to control the hole size for its intended function."}]}
